refundSurchargeAdvice.title: ResourceURL<RefundSurchargeAdvice>
refundSurchargeAdvice.description: Refund Surcharge Advice [Resource URL](#section/Overview/Values) obtained through the create refundSurchargeAdvice API call.

parentTransaction.title: ResourceURL<Transaction>
parentTransaction.description: Transaction [Resource URL](#section/Overview/Values) of the parent Transaction

description.description: Description, which appears on the dashboard and might appear on receipts

shopperStatement.description: Dynamic overrides of what might appear on a shopper's statement

customReference.description: Optional reference provided by the merchant

shopperReference.description: Optional reference provided by the shopper, such as a purchase order

shopperEmailAddress.description: Shopper's email address, useful for fraud detection and to provide a receipt

shopperIpAddress.description: Shopper's IP address, useful for fraud detection

shopperLanguageTag.description: Shopper's IETF language tag, useful for localising the receipt

shopperTimeZone.description: Shopper's time zone, specified by the IANA Time Zone Database name

createdBy.description: Who or what created the transaction? When created in Elavon's virtual terminal, this will be the email address of the currently logged in user. When created otherwise, the integrator may optionally provide any value that helps answer this question.

customFields.description: Custom fields, an object containing arbitrary string values.  Field names and values must not exceed 64 and 1024 characters, respectively.

doCapture.description: If false, authorize only; if true (default), authorize and capture funds for settlement.

doSendReceipt.description: Send receipt to shopper's email address. Default value is based on the merchant's back office configuration.
